project.name: Private Agent UI 优化
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Apple-style personal assistant UI, #007aff primary blue, Inter font, light glassmorphism surfaces, clean minimal layout
project.designRead: desktop assistant app / power users / clean professional / moderate density / avoid visual clutter

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: #007aff primary, #f5f5f7 page bg, #ffffff surface, #1d1d1f text, #34c759 success, #ff9500 warning, #ff3b30 error
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: 8px sm, 12px md, 16px lg, 9999px full; rounded cards and pills
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: glassmorphism cards, blue accent CTAs, subtle shadows, breathing animations
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-first static surfaces, glass blur for floating layers, shadow alpha <= 0.05 for static
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: line-style SVG icons, emoji for weather, no photographic imagery
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: smooth cubic-bezier transitions, breathing pulses, 200ms delays for ritual feel

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-first static, glass for floating, shadow <= 0.05 alpha static

pages.title: 入场动画
pages.visualNorthStar: Sci-fi boot sequence with NEXTBOT title reveal, blurred particle field, and horizontal scan light sweep
pages.requirements: 200ms initial black screen delay for boot ritual; particle field using filter:blur(1px) light spots instead of solid dots; NEXTBOT title with gradient fill and horizontal scan sweep; SYSTEM ONLINE subtitle; total duration ~4s then fade out

pages.title: 主聊天界面
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean Apple-style chat interface with weather integrated into right panel schedule card header
pages.requirements: Remove dynamic island from header; move weather info (temp, condition, trend, alert) into right panel above schedule card as a compact weather strip; keep chat messages, input area, sidebar, tools, and pet avatar; merge consecutive AI message avatars; use unified CSS variables

pages.title: 电话窗口
pages.visualNorthStar: Three phone call window states with refined glassmorphism and subtle breathing glows
pages.requirements: Three window states: incoming call (300x88 compact bar), outgoing call (384x224 centered card), connected call (384x296 full panel); softer breathing glow (scale 1 to 1.12 not 1.27); unified color palette with CSS variables; green accept button with pulse, red reject button; timer with tabular-nums

pages.title: 思考动画
pages.visualNorthStar: Canvas-driven organic wave border animation with sequential status text progression
pages.requirements: Canvas organic wave engine with primary/detail/burst waves; sequential status text (理解意图→检索信息→推理中→组织答案) not random; intensity slider; send button pulse; unified CSS variables
